channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Porter Medical Center nurses in Middlebury have approved a new three-year contract with annual wage increases. The deal includes better shift differentials, incentive pay, and bereavement leave. It covers one hundred forty-three nurses and was ratified by eighty percent of union voters.
A woman was rescued after her car crashed into the water on the Vermont shore of the Connecticut River Wednesday afternoon. Emergency responders quickly acted to get her out safely.

Mill River School Superintendent Cheryl Gonzalez said some high school classes are below new size minimums under Act seventy-three. The district is also short on bus drivers, causing reduced routes. They hope to hire a new driver before the end of the month.

Firefighters contained a brush fire in Ferrisburgh caused by an unpermitted burn pile. The fire spread to a nearby garage but was quickly knocked down. Officials remind residents that burn permits are required for any fire other than a campfire.
